component.name: LibreLinkUp Rust Desktop
component.summary: Monitor blood glucose readings from LibreLinkUp

description.p: Native Rust and KDE Plasma 6 Kirigami desktop client for monitoring continuous blood glucose readings from LibreLinkUp, with zero tracking and zero advertisements — forever.

ul.li: Zero tracking, zero analytics, and zero advertisements — forever
Home Assistant LibreLink integration with automatic multi-patient discovery and selector, sensor warmup/expiry countdown, two-way medication & dose sync, and cross-device alert snooze synchronization
Accessibility support with WCAG AA/AAA High Contrast mode, full-window UI zoom (75%–175%), screen-reader announcements, and status bar connection badge
AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 encrypted vaults for credentials, 90-day glucose history, and medications
Medications tab with Once Daily, Twice Daily, Weekly (day-of-week), and As-Needed schedules, 1-click dose logging, interactive desktop due-dose reminders, and 12-hour glucose graph dose markers
90-day Glycemic Analytics computing ADAG Estimated A1C (eA1C), Bergenstal GMI, Time in Range (TIR%), and CV% across 12h, 7d, 14d, 30d, and 90d windows
Dynamic system tray badge showing live blood glucose value and hover tooltip
Native KDE Plasma 6 Light, Dark, and System theme support
Interactive 12-hour CGM trend graph with point hover inspection and medication markers
Floating desktop overlay widget with Dark Theme, on-card control buttons, scroll-wheel adjustable transparency, and persistent multi-monitor placement
Stale-reading detection with signal-loss alerts, urgent-low/repeat/snooze alert engine, and built-in audible alarm sound
Built-in diagnostic Log Viewer with filtering, search, and export

screenshot.caption: Live blood glucose dashboard, multi-patient selector, sensor expiry countdown, eA1C/GMI analytics, and 12-hour trend graph
Home Assistant LibreLink integration with multi-patient selector, two-way medication sync, and cross-device alert snooze
Medications tab with scheduled dose checklist, eA1C/GMI glycemic analytics, and recent dose log
Appearance, accessibility UI zoom and High Contrast mode, system tray badge, and floating desktop overlay settings

description.p: Fix infinite overlayOnlyMode event loop and 100% CPU lockup when main window is closed with desktop overlay visible; eliminate per-tick disk reads and redundant JSON/D-Bus updates

Ploopy hi-res wheel scrolling, wide high-contrast scrollbars across all tabs, primary-screen centering & window placement persistence, header overflow fix on tray restore, and Medications documentation

Security hardening release: signed auto-updates (minisign), encryption at rest for glucose history and medication data, fail-closed staleness detection, re-auth backoff, and a three-controller architecture split.
Existing installs must update manually once to v0.5.0 before signed auto-updates work.
Alert notification snooze actions, SHA-256 verified updater, desktop keyring & opt-in password vault, LibreView region allowlist, PII redaction, and modular core/bridge/C++ architecture
Add On All Desktops toggle button and setting for floating desktop overlay
Add periodic background auto-update version checking (every 6h) and one-click in-app update installer for Linux Flatpak & Windows
Update dependencies: tokio 1.54.1, async-compression 0.4.51, cc 1.9.0, compression-codecs 0.4.46, compression-core 0.4.34, crc32fast 1.5.3 (+17 more)
Fix regional endpoint selection (e.g. FI -> api-eu.libreview.io), add ISO country-to-region normalization, and auto-heal stored credential vaults.
New native Windows 10/11 version that shares its core with the Linux app. On Linux, the code was restructured into a shared core library; there are no functional changes.
Safety, reliability and Flatpak sandboxing improvements.

ul.li: Stale-reading detection: readings show their age and turn gray when no new data arrives, with an optional signal-loss alert
New alert engine with an urgent-low threshold, configurable repeat interval and snooze
Audible built-in alarm sound and desktop notifications for alerts
Network requests no longer freeze the window
Settings and credentials are stored in the Flatpak sandbox, and login autostart uses the Background portal
Credentials are no longer passed on command lines
The header adapts to larger desktop fonts

description.p: Added persistent multi-monitor overlay placement, task-manager-free floating overlay mode, strict layout overflow guards, and updated documentation.
Initial release of LibreLinkUp Rust Desktop for KDE Plasma 6.
